title: 雷射散斑抑制
summary: 從雷射照在粗糙屏幕上的隨機相量和出發，理解散斑對比 C = σ/⟨I⟩ 為何只能靠疊加獨立圖樣以 1/√N 降低，再把角度、偏振與波長多樣性、移動擴散片、多模光纖、等效人眼相機、投影鏡頭光展量與壽命驗收整合成可交接的散斑抑制工程。
summaryEn: Start from the random phasor sum of laser light on a rough screen to see why speckle contrast C = σ/⟨I⟩ falls only as 1/√N by stacking independent patterns, then integrate angle, polarization and wavelength diversity, moving diffusers, multimode fibers, eye-equivalent cameras, projection-lens étendue and lifetime acceptance into a transferable speckle-reduction record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「散斑的形成與統計」與「1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Speckle formation and statistics" and "The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 散斑的形成與統計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Speckle formation and statistics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」如何決定雷射散斑抑制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Screen roughness and observer pupil” determines the key performance of “Laser-speckle reduction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。當相位完全隨機且散射子很多時，強度服從負指數分布，散斑對比 C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1，稱為完全發展的散斑；去偏振屏幕把光分成兩個獨立偏振的散斑圖，C 降到 1/√2。人眼看到的是主觀散斑，顆粒大小由觀察者瞳孔而非屏幕決定，所以同一畫面在明亮環境下瞳孔縮小時，散斑更粗、更明顯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum. With fully random phases and many scatterers the intensity follows a negative-exponential distribution and the speckle contrast C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1, called fully developed speckle; a depolarizing screen splits the light into two independent polarization patterns and C falls to 1/√2. The eye sees subjective speckle whose grain size is set by the observer's pupil rather than the screen, so the same picture shows coarser, more visible speckle in bright surroundings where the pupil contracts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Screen roughness and observer pupil”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：完全發展散斑 P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩：亮度超過平均 3 倍的面積佔 e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，低於平均 10% 的暗點佔 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For fully developed speckle P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩: the area brighter than three times the mean is e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, and dark spots below 10% of the mean cover 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「散斑是屏幕上固定的圖案，從任何位置看都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Speckle is a fixed pattern on the screen and looks the same from anywhere." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Screen roughness and observer pupil”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 散斑的形成與統計
knowledge.text: 同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。當相位完全隨機且散射子很多時，強度服從負指數分布，散斑對比 C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1，稱為完全發展的散斑；去偏振屏幕把光分成兩個獨立偏振的散斑圖，C 降到 1/√2。
knowledge.textEn: When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum. With fully random phases and many scatterers the intensity follows a negative-exponential distribution and the speckle contrast C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1, called fully developed speckle; a depolarizing screen splits the light into two independent polarization patterns and C falls to 1/√2.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：散斑是屏幕上固定的圖案，從任何位置看都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Speckle is a fixed pattern on the screen and looks the same from anywhere. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「雷射散斑抑制」的「散斑的形成與統計：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Speckle formation and statistics: mechanism and system boundary” in “Laser-speckle reduction”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「散斑的形成與統計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speckle formation and statistics" is correct?
options: 散斑是屏幕上固定的圖案，從任何位置看都一樣。
同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。
只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。
optionsEn: Speckle is a fixed pattern on the screen and looks the same from anywhere.

When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum.
A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 散斑的形成與統計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speckle formation and statistics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Screen roughness and observer pupil” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：完全發展散斑 P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩：亮度超過平均 3 倍的面積佔 e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，低於平均 10% 的暗點佔 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%。主觀散斑投回屏幕的顆粒直徑 ≈ 2.44λL/D：λ = 532 nm、觀看距離 L = 3 m、瞳孔 D = 3 mm 時 ≈ 1.30 mm，比眼睛 1 角分在 3 m 處對應的 0.87 mm 還大，因此清楚可見；瞳孔放大到 6 mm 時縮為 0.65 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For fully developed speckle P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩: the area brighter than three times the mean is e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, and dark spots below 10% of the mean cover 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%. The subjective grain diameter projected back onto the screen is ≈ 2.44λL/D: with λ = 532 nm, viewing distance L = 3 m and pupil D = 3 mm it is ≈ 1.30 mm, larger than the 0.87 mm that one arcminute of eye resolution spans at 3 m, so it is clearly visible; a 6 mm pupil shrinks it to 0.65 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以單模綠光雷射照亮白色擴散屏，用單色相機在 3 m 處、入瞳直徑 3 mm、對焦於屏面拍攝，計算中央區塊的 σ/⟨I⟩ 與強度直方圖，加檢偏器時應接近負指數分布且 C ≈ 1，去偏振屏不加檢偏器時 C ≈ 0.71；再改變入瞳直徑，確認顆粒大小與 1/D 成正比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate a white diffusing screen with a single-mode green laser and photograph it with a monochrome camera at 3 m with a 3 mm entrance pupil focused on the screen; compute σ/⟨I⟩ and the intensity histogram of a central block, which with an analyser should approach a negative exponential with C ≈ 1 and on a depolarizing screen without analyser give C ≈ 0.71; then vary the entrance-pupil diameter and confirm that grain size scales as 1/D.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 完全發展散斑 P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩：亮度超過平均 3 倍的面積佔 e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，低於平均 10% 的暗點佔 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%。主觀散斑投回屏幕的顆粒直徑 ≈ 2.44λL/D：λ = 532 nm、觀看距離 L = 3 m、瞳孔 D = 3 mm 時 ≈ 1.30 mm，比眼睛 1 角分在 3 m 處對應的 0.87 mm 還大，因此清楚可見；瞳孔放大到 6 mm 時縮為 0.65 mm。
knowledge.textEn: For fully developed speckle P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩: the area brighter than three times the mean is e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, and dark spots below 10% of the mean cover 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%. The subjective grain diameter projected back onto the screen is ≈ 2.44λL/D: with λ = 532 nm, viewing distance L = 3 m and pupil D = 3 mm it is ≈ 1.30 mm, larger than the 0.87 mm that one arcminute of eye resolution spans at 3 m, so it is clearly visible; a 6 mm pupil shrinks it to 0.65 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「散斑的形成與統計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Speckle formation and statistics", which statement holds?
options: 用多模光纖傳光，輸出就一定是非同調、無散斑的。
影像標準差除以平均值，就是散斑對比。
完全發展散斑 P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩：亮度超過平均 3 倍的面積佔 e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，低於平均 10% 的暗點佔 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%。
optionsEn: Light through a multimode fiber always emerges incoherent and speckle-free.
Image standard deviation over mean is the speckle contrast.
For fully developed speckle P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩: the area brighter than three times the mean is e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, and dark spots below 10% of the mean cover 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%.
quiz.explanation: 完全發展散斑 P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩：亮度超過平均 3 倍的面積佔 e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，低於平均 10% 的暗點佔 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For fully developed speckle P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩: the area brighter than three times the mean is e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, and dark spots below 10% of the mean cover 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 散斑的形成與統計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speckle formation and statistics: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Screen roughness and observer pupil” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以單模綠光雷射照亮白色擴散屏，用單色相機在 3 m 處、入瞳直徑 3 mm、對焦於屏面拍攝，計算中央區塊的 σ/⟨I⟩ 與強度直方圖，加檢偏器時應接近負指數分布且 C ≈ 1，去偏振屏不加檢偏器時 C ≈ 0.71；再改變入瞳直徑，確認顆粒大小與 1/D 成正比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate a white diffusing screen with a single-mode green laser and photograph it with a monochrome camera at 3 m with a 3 mm entrance pupil focused on the screen; compute σ/⟨I⟩ and the intensity histogram of a central block, which with an analyser should approach a negative exponential with C ≈ 1 and on a depolarizing screen without analyser give C ≈ 0.71; then vary the entrance-pupil diameter and confirm that grain size scales as 1/D. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以單模綠光雷射照亮白色擴散屏，用單色相機在 3 m 處、入瞳直徑 3 mm、對焦於屏面拍攝，計算中央區塊的 σ/⟨I⟩ 與強度直方圖，加檢偏器時應接近負指數分布且 C ≈ 1，去偏振屏不加檢偏器時 C ≈ 0.71；再改變入瞳直徑，確認顆粒大小與 1/D 成正比。
knowledge.textEn: Illuminate a white diffusing screen with a single-mode green laser and photograph it with a monochrome camera at 3 m with a 3 mm entrance pupil focused on the screen; compute σ/⟨I⟩ and the intensity histogram of a central block, which with an analyser should approach a negative exponential with C ≈ 1 and on a depolarizing screen without analyser give C ≈ 0.71; then vary the entrance-pupil diameter and confirm that grain size scales as 1/D.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「散斑的形成與統計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speckle formation and statistics"?
options: 以單模綠光雷射照亮白色擴散屏，用單色相機在 3 m 處、入瞳直徑 3 mm、對焦於屏面拍攝，計算中央區塊的 σ/⟨I⟩ 與強度直方圖，加檢偏器時應接近負指數分布且 C ≈ 1，去偏振屏不加檢偏器時 C ≈ 0.71。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
擴散片的擴散角越大，散斑抑制效果就越好。
optionsEn: Illuminate a white diffusing screen with a single-mode green laser and photograph it with a monochrome camera at 3 m with a 3 mm entrance pupil focused on the screen.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A wider diffuser angle always gives better speckle reduction.
quiz.explanation: 以單模綠光雷射照亮白色擴散屏，用單色相機在 3 m 處、入瞳直徑 3 mm、對焦於屏面拍攝，計算中央區塊的 σ/⟨I⟩ 與強度直方圖，加檢偏器時應接近負指數分布且 C ≈ 1，去偏振屏不加檢偏器時 C ≈ 0.71；再改變入瞳直徑，確認顆粒大小與 1/D 成正比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Illuminate a white diffusing screen with a single-mode green laser and photograph it with a monochrome camera at 3 m with a 3 mm entrance pupil focused on the screen; compute σ/⟨I⟩ and the intensity histogram of a central block, which with an analyser should approach a negative exponential with C ≈ 1 and on a depolarizing screen without analyser give C ≈ 0.71; then vary the entrance-pupil diameter and confirm that grain size scales as 1/D. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 散斑的形成與統計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speckle formation and statistics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Screen roughness and observer pupil” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人眼看到的是主觀散斑，顆粒大小由觀察者瞳孔而非屏幕決定，所以同一畫面在明亮環境下瞳孔縮小時，散斑更粗、更明顯。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The eye sees subjective speckle whose grain size is set by the observer's pupil rather than the screen, so the same picture shows coarser, more visible speckle in bright surroundings where the pupil contracts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「散斑是屏幕上固定的圖案，從任何位置看都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Speckle is a fixed pattern on the screen and looks the same from anywhere." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。
knowledge.textEn: Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「散斑的形成與統計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Speckle formation and statistics" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。
只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes.
A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」如何決定雷射散斑抑制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity” determines the key performance of “Laser-speckle reduction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。獨立圖樣來自三種多樣性：照明角度（投影光瞳相對觀察者瞳孔的立體角比）、偏振（最多 2 個圖樣）與波長（光源頻寬相對屏幕路徑差所需的去相關波長）。三者相乘得總縮減因子 R = R_角·R_偏·R_λ，每一項都有物理上限，所以設計要先把目標 C 換算成所需的 N，再分配給各項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity; intensity addition gives C = 1/√N. Independent patterns come from three diversities: illumination angle (the solid-angle ratio of projection pupil to observer pupil), polarization (at most two patterns) and wavelength (source bandwidth relative to the decorrelation wavelength set by the screen's path-length spread). They multiply into a total reduction factor R = R_angle·R_pol·R_λ, each with a physical ceiling, so design first converts the target C into the required N and then allocates it among the three. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：目標 C = 4%（教學假設）需 N = 1/0.04² = 625，R = 25。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A target C = 4% (teaching assumption) needs N = 1/0.04² = 625, R = 25.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算
knowledge.titleEn: The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget
knowledge.text: 降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。獨立圖樣來自三種多樣性：照明角度（投影光瞳相對觀察者瞳孔的立體角比）、偏振（最多 2 個圖樣）與波長（光源頻寬相對屏幕路徑差所需的去相關波長）。
knowledge.textEn: The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity; intensity addition gives C = 1/√N. Independent patterns come from three diversities: illumination angle (the solid-angle ratio of projection pupil to observer pupil), polarization (at most two patterns) and wavelength (source bandwidth relative to the decorrelation wavelength set by the screen's path-length spread).

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget" is correct?
options: 只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。
擴散片轉得越快，散斑就可以無限降低。
降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。
optionsEn: A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant.
Spinning the diffuser faster lowers speckle without limit.
The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity.
quiz.explanation: 降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity; intensity addition gives C = 1/√N. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：目標 C = 4%（教學假設）需 N = 1/0.04² = 625，R = 25。偏振 R_偏 = √2。波長：多發射體雷射頻寬 2 nm，同調長度 l_c = λ²/Δλ ≈ 142 µm；體擴散屏路徑差展開 0.5 mm 時 N_λ ≈ 500/142 ≈ 3.5，R_λ ≈ 1.88。剩下 R_角 = 25/(1.41×1.88) ≈ 9.4，N_角 ≈ 88；同距離下 R_角 = D_投/D_眼，3 mm 瞳孔要求投影光瞳被時變照明填滿至 28 mm。若屏幕只有 20 µm 表面散射，N_λ < 1，波長多樣性完全無效。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A target C = 4% (teaching assumption) needs N = 1/0.04² = 625, R = 25. Polarization gives R_pol = √2. For wavelength, a multi-emitter laser with 2 nm bandwidth has coherence length l_c = λ²/Δλ ≈ 142 µm; a volume-diffusing screen with 0.5 mm path spread gives N_λ ≈ 500/142 ≈ 3.5, R_λ ≈ 1.88. That leaves R_angle = 25/(1.41×1.88) ≈ 9.4, N_angle ≈ 88; at equal distances R_angle = D_proj/D_eye, so a 3 mm pupil demands a projection pupil filled with time-varying illumination out to 28 mm. A surface-only screen with 20 µm spread gives N_λ < 1 and wavelength diversity does nothing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分項量測：比較加與不加檢偏器的 C，比值應接近 √2；以光譜儀量光源頻寬，在同一屏幕上比較單模與多發射體光源的 C；以可變光闌改變照明光瞳直徑，畫 C 對 D_投 的曲線，應隨 1/D_投 下降，直到積分時間內的獨立圖樣不足而飽和。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each term: compare C with and without an analyser, expecting a ratio near √2; measure source bandwidth with a spectrometer and compare C for single-mode and multi-emitter sources on the same screen; vary the illumination pupil with an iris and plot C against D_proj, which should fall as 1/D_proj until too few independent patterns fit in the integration time and it saturates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 目標 C = 4%（教學假設）需 N = 1/0.04² = 625，R = 25。偏振 R_偏 = √2。波長：多發射體雷射頻寬 2 nm，同調長度 l_c = λ²/Δλ ≈ 142 µm；體擴散屏路徑差展開 0.5 mm 時 N_λ ≈ 500/142 ≈ 3.5，R_λ ≈ 1.88。剩下 R_角 = 25/(1.41×1.88) ≈ 9.4，N_角 ≈ 88；同距離下 R_角 = D_投/D_眼，3 mm 瞳孔要求投影光瞳被時變照明填滿至 28 mm。若屏幕只有 20 µm 表面散射，N_λ < 1，波長多樣性完全無效。
knowledge.textEn: A target C = 4% (teaching assumption) needs N = 1/0.04² = 625, R = 25. Polarization gives R_pol = √2. For wavelength, a multi-emitter laser with 2 nm bandwidth has coherence length l_c = λ²/Δλ ≈ 142 µm; a volume-diffusing screen with 0.5 mm path spread gives N_λ ≈ 500/142 ≈ 3.5, R_λ ≈ 1.88. That leaves R_angle = 25/(1.41×1.88) ≈ 9.4, N_angle ≈ 88; at equal distances R_angle = D_proj/D_eye, so a 3 mm pupil demands a projection pupil filled with time-varying illumination out to 28 mm. A surface-only screen with 20 µm spread gives N_λ < 1 and wavelength diversity does nothing.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget", which statement holds?
options: 散斑對比是屏幕或光源的固有規格，與量測相機無關。
擴散片的擴散角越大，散斑抑制效果就越好。
optionsEn: A target C = 4% (teaching assumption) needs N = 1/0.04² = 625, R = 25.
Speckle contrast is intrinsic to screen or source, independent of the measuring camera.
A wider diffuser angle always gives better speckle reduction.
quiz.explanation: 目標 C = 4%（教學假設）需 N = 1/0.04² = 625，R = 25。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A target C = 4% (teaching assumption) needs N = 1/0.04² = 625, R = 25. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 分項量測：比較加與不加檢偏器的 C，比值應接近 √2；以光譜儀量光源頻寬，在同一屏幕上比較單模與多發射體光源的 C；以可變光闌改變照明光瞳直徑，畫 C 對 D_投 的曲線，應隨 1/D_投 下降，直到積分時間內的獨立圖樣不足而飽和。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each term: compare C with and without an analyser, expecting a ratio near √2; measure source bandwidth with a spectrometer and compare C for single-mode and multi-emitter sources on the same screen; vary the illumination pupil with an iris and plot C against D_proj, which should fall as 1/D_proj until too few independent patterns fit in the integration time and it saturates. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：設計只看光源頻寬：同一顆 2 nm 光源在體擴散屏上合格，換成表面金屬化的保偏 3D 銀幕後波長與偏振多樣性同時消失，C 回升約 2.7 倍，直到影院現場安裝才發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The design looked only at source bandwidth: the same 2 nm source passes on a volume-diffusing screen, but on a metallized polarization-preserving 3D silver screen both wavelength and polarization diversity vanish and C rises about 2.7-fold, discovered only at cinema installation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分項量測：比較加與不加檢偏器的 C，比值應接近 √2；以光譜儀量光源頻寬，在同一屏幕上比較單模與多發射體光源的 C；以可變光闌改變照明光瞳直徑，畫 C 對 D_投 的曲線，應隨 1/D_投 下降，直到積分時間內的獨立圖樣不足而飽和。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each term: compare C with and without an analyser, expecting a ratio near √2; measure source bandwidth with a spectrometer and compare C for single-mode and multi-emitter sources on the same screen; vary the illumination pupil with an iris and plot C against D_proj, which should fall as 1/D_proj until too few independent patterns fit in the integration time and it saturates.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
分項量測：比較加與不加檢偏器的 C，比值應接近 √2。
在畫面中央量一次合格，整個畫面就都合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure each term: compare C with and without an analyser, expecting a ratio near √2.
One passing measurement at screen centre means the whole picture passes.
quiz.explanation: 分項量測：比較加與不加檢偏器的 C，比值應接近 √2；以光譜儀量光源頻寬，在同一屏幕上比較單模與多發射體光源的 C；以可變光闌改變照明光瞳直徑，畫 C 對 D_投 的曲線，應隨 1/D_投 下降，直到積分時間內的獨立圖樣不足而飽和。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each term: compare C with and without an analyser, expecting a ratio near √2; measure source bandwidth with a spectrometer and compare C for single-mode and multi-emitter sources on the same screen; vary the illumination pupil with an iris and plot C against D_proj, which should fall as 1/D_proj until too few independent patterns fit in the integration time and it saturates. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 設計只看光源頻寬：同一顆 2 nm 光源在體擴散屏上合格，換成表面金屬化的保偏 3D 銀幕後波長與偏振多樣性同時消失，C 回升約 2.7 倍，直到影院現場安裝才發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The design looked only at source bandwidth: the same 2 nm source passes on a volume-diffusing screen, but on a metallized polarization-preserving 3D silver screen both wavelength and polarization diversity vanish and C rises about 2.7-fold, discovered only at cinema installation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三者相乘得總縮減因子 R = R_角·R_偏·R_λ，每一項都有物理上限，所以設計要先把目標 C 換算成所需的 N，再分配給各項。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: They multiply into a total reduction factor R = R_angle·R_pol·R_λ, each with a physical ceiling, so design first converts the target C into the required N and then allocates it among the three.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: The design looked only at source bandwidth: the same 2 nm source passes on a volume-diffusing screen, but on a metallized polarization-preserving 3D silver screen both wavelength and polarization diversity vanish and C rises about 2.7-fold, discovered only at cinema installation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
擴散片轉得越快，散斑就可以無限降低。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Spinning the diffuser faster lowers speckle without limit.
